title: Agent Turn Time Breakdown
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Calculate the time of one agent turn from its tokens, speeds, and tool time, name the part that dominates, then explore five inputs.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the time of an agent turn from its prompt tokens, reply tokens, speeds, and tool time to within 1 second, and name the component that dominates it, for 3 challenges.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Committed calculation with two attempts, followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: Challenge 2 is almost six times slower than challenge 1, and its model generates only a little more slowly. Explain where the time went.
commonMisconceptions: Faster generation always makes a turn faster.
A model's speed is one number for every workload.
Re-reading happens only when the context is full.
